pages.title: Regional History
pages.text_en:
Kilimanjaro Region was officially established in 1963 through Government Notice No. 450 of that year, comprising the districts of Kilimanjaro and Pare.
Before Independence, Kilimanjaro Region was part of the Northern Province, which consisted of the districts of Arusha and Mbulu, while Pare District was part of Tanga Province.
When our country gained Independence on 9 December 1961, the Provincial Commissioner of the Northern Province was Hon. PC Edward Barongo, who served until 1963. He was succeeded by Hon. Peter Kisumo, who became the first Regional Commissioner of Kilimanjaro Region.
pages.text_sw:
Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro ulianzishwa rasmi mwaka 1963 kwa Tangazo la serikali Na.450 la mwaka huo ukiwa na wilaya za Kilimanjaro na Pare.
Kabla ya Uhuru Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro ulikuwa ni sehemu ya Jimbo la kaskazini (Nothern Province) lililokuwa linaundwa na wilaya za Arusha na Mbulu, Wakati wilaya ya Pare ilikuwa sehemu ya jimbo la Tanga (Tanga Province).
Wakati nchi yetu inapata Uhuru tarehe 9/12/1961 Mkuu wa jimbo la Kaskazini (Provincial Commissioner) alikuwa Mhe.PC Edward Barongo ambaye aliongoza hadi 1963 na kufuatiwa na Mhe. Peter Kisumo, Mkuu wa Mkoa wa kwanza wa Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro.

pages.title: Vision and Mission
pages.text_en:
VISION
To become a leading region in economic and social development by 2031.
MISSION
To enhance economic and social development by providing good governance services and professional advisory support to Local Government Authorities (LGAs) and other stakeholders.
pages.text_sw:
DIRA
“Kuwa Mkoa Unaoongoza kwa Maendeleo ya Kiuchumi na Kijamii ifikapo 2031”
DHIMA
“Kuboresha Maendeleo ya Kiuchumi na Kijamii kwa Kutoa Huduma za Utawala Bora na Ushauri wa Kitaalam kwa Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa (MSM) na Wadau Wengine”

pages.title: Health, Social Welfare and Nutrition Section
pages.text_en:
Health, Social Welfare and Nutrition Section
This Section performs the following activities:
(i) Coordinates and advises on the implementation of health policies in the Region.
(ii) Coordinates the planning and execution of health services, social welfare, and environmental sanitation in the Region.
(iii) Coordinates the management of health facilities in the Region.
(iv) Monitors and evaluates the management of health services provided by public and private sector health facilities in the Region.
(v) Provides support for capacity building to LGAs in health service delivery.
(vi) Advises the RS and LGAs on capacity development to combat disease outbreaks.
(vii) Provides advice on HIV/AIDS activities in the Region.
(viii) Promotes community engagement and the use of health insurance.
(ix) Provides backstopping support during health epidemics in the Region.
(x) Coordinates and updates data on health, social welfare, and nutrition services for LGAs.
(xi) Provides technical support on nutrition interventions to LGAs.
(xii) Coordinates preventive health services.
(xiii) Facilitates and coordinates environmental health and sanitation issues in the Region.
(xiv) Coordinates the availability of pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and medical supplies for health facilities in the Region.
pages.text_sw:
Sehemu ya Afya, Ustawi wa Jamii na Lishe
Sehemu hii inatekeleza shughuli zifuatazo:
(i) Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kuhusu utekelezaji wa sera za afya katika Mkoa.
(ii) Kuratibu mipango na utekelezaji wa huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na usafi wa mazingira katika Mkoa.
(iii) Kuratibu usimamizi wa vituo vya kutolea huduma za afya katika Mkoa.
(iv) Kufuatilia na kutathmini usimamizi wa huduma za afya zinazotolewa na vituo vya afya vya sekta ya umma na binafsi katika Mkoa.
(v) Kutoa msaada wa kujenga uwezo kwa Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa (LGAs) katika utoaji wa huduma za afya.
(vi) Kushauri RS na LGAs kuhusu maandalizi ya kujenga uwezo wa kukabiliana na milipuko ya magonjwa.
(vii) Kutoa ushauri kuhusu shughuli za UKIMWI (HIV/AIDS) katika Mkoa.
(viii) Kuhamasisha ushiriki wa jamii na matumizi ya bima ya afya.
(ix) Kutoa msaada wa kitaalamu wakati wa milipuko ya magonjwa katika Mkoa.
(x) Kuratibu na kusasisha takwimu za afya, ustawi wa jamii na huduma za lishe kwa LGAs.
(xi) Kutoa msaada wa kitaalamu kuhusu utekelezaji wa afua za lishe kwa LGAs.
(xii) Kuratibu huduma za kinga za afya.
(xiii) Kuwezesha na kuratibu masuala ya afya ya mazingira na usafi katika Mkoa.
(xiv) Kuratibu upatikanaji wa dawa, vifaa tiba na mahitaji ya kitabibu kwa vituo vya kutolea huduma za afya katika Mkoa.

pages.title: Infrastructure Section
pages.text_en:
Infrastructure Section
This Section performs the following activities:
(i) Coordinates and monitors the implementation of policies on roads, buildings, energy, sewage, water, and communication.
(ii) Supervises the construction and rehabilitation of office and residential buildings under the RS.
(iii) Liaises with relevant authorities in the Central and Local Governments on engineering matters.
(iv) Oversees and advises on structural engineering works undertaken in the Region.
(v) Provides secretarial services to the Regional Road Board.
(vi) Monitors and evaluates road and building works in LGAs and Tanzania Rural and Urban Roads Agency.
pages.text_sw:
Sehemu ya Miundombinu
Sehemu hii inatekeleza shughuli zifuatazo:
(i) Kuratibu na kufuatilia utekelezaji wa sera zinazohusu barabara, majengo, nishati, maji taka, maji na mawasiliano.
(ii) Kusimamia ujenzi na ukarabati wa majengo ya ofisi na makazi yaliyo chini ya RS.
(iii) Kushirikiana na mamlaka husika za Serikali Kuu na Serikali za Mitaa katika masuala ya uhandisi.
(iv) Kusimamia na kutoa ushauri kuhusu kazi za uhandisi wa miundombinu zinazotekelezwa katika Mkoa.
(v) Kutoa huduma za sekretarieti kwa Bodi ya Barabara ya Mkoa.
(vi) Kufuatilia na kutathmini kazi za ujenzi wa barabara na majengo katika Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa (LGAs) na Tanzania Rural and Urban Roads Agency.

pages.title: Community Development Unit
pages.text_en:
Community Development Unit
The Unit performs the following activities:
(i) Analyses, interprets and supervises the implementation of policies, strategies, laws, guidelines and international conventions related to good governance, community development, gender, special needs groups, children, parenting and family development in the Region.
(ii) Facilitates community participation (self-help efforts and volunteerism) in planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of their projects to solve social and economic challenges at the LGA level.
(iii) Provides technical support to LGAs on the Opportunities and Obstacles to Development (Improved O&OD) planning approach.
(iv) Tracks and evaluates the facilitation fund for women, youths and people with disabilities.
(v) Promotes community sensitization programmes on patriotism, volunteerism and the spirit of self-help to support social and economic development at local and national levels in LGAs.
(vi) Coordinates and ensures sound projects from groups of women, youths and people with disabilities.
(vii) Coordinates the implementation of cross-cutting issues including gender, disability and HIV/AIDS at the Regional level.
(viii) Facilitates and coordinates the operations of economic empowerment programs and projects in LGAs.
(ix) Coordinates and monitors Civil Society Organizations (NGOs, FBOs and CBOs) in the implementation of programs and projects within communities in the Region.
(x) Promotes and facilitates Public-Private Partnership initiatives in implementing programs and projects to meet community needs in LGAs.
pages.text_sw:
Kitengo cha Maendeleo ya Jamii
Kitengo hiki hufanya shughuli zifuatazo:
(i) Kuchambua, kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, mikakati, sheria, miongozo na makubaliano ya kimataifa yanayohusiana na utawala bora, maendeleo ya jamii, jinsia, makundi yenye mahitaji maalum, watoto, malezi na maendeleo ya familia katika Mkoa.
(ii) Kuwezesha ushiriki wa jamii (jitihada za kujitegemea na kujitolea) katika kupanga, kutekeleza, kufuatilia na kutathmini miradi yao ili kutatua changamoto za kijamii na kiuchumi katika ngazi ya Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa (LGAs).
(iii) Kutoa msaada wa kitaalamu kwa LGAs kuhusu mbinu ya mipango ya Fursa na Vikwazo kwa Maendeleo (Improved O&OD) .
(iv) Kufuatilia na kutathmini mfuko wa uwezeshaji kwa wanawake, vijana na watu wenye ulemavu.
(v) Kukuza programu za uhamasishaji wa jamii kuhusu uzalendo, kujitolea na ari ya kujitegemea ili kuleta maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi katika ngazi za mitaa na kitaifa ndani ya LGAs.
(vi) Kuratibu na kuhakikisha uwepo wa miradi bora kutoka kwa makundi ya wanawake, vijana na watu wenye ulemavu.
(vii) Kuratibu utekelezaji wa masuala mtambuka ikiwemo jinsia, ulemavu na UKIMWI katika ngazi ya Mkoa.
(viii) Kuwezesha na kuratibu utekelezaji wa programu na miradi ya uwezeshaji wa kiuchumi katika LGAs.
(ix) Kuratibu na kufuatilia utekelezaji wa programu na miradi ya Asasi za Kiraia (NGOs, FBOs na CBOs) katika jamii ndani ya Mkoa.
(x) Kukuza na kuwezesha mipango ya Ushirikiano kati ya Sekta ya Umma na Sekta Binafsi (PPP) katika utekelezaji wa programu na miradi ili kukidhi mahitaji ya jamii katika LGAs.
